newsitem.title: GERMANY: British Regional Airways adds Hanover-Manchester flights.
newsitem.headline: British Regional Airways adds Hanover-Manchester flights.

text.p: British Airways plc said its franchisee British Regional Airlines will launch daily Hanover-Manchester flights from March 30.
The regional carrier will start operations with ATR turboprop aircraft before switching to a 49-seat Embraer 145 jet aircraft in the summer, BA said.
British Regional Airlines is a subsidiary of The BBW Partnership which flies various European routes under a BA franchise agreement.
The BBW Partnership also owns 60 percent of Airlines of Britain Holdings, the parent company of British Midland Airways.
